items.headline: Tyler Shough, dubbed 'Poor man' by Saints, leads win vs. Ravens
items.description: After Ravens DC Anthony Weaver attempted to pay Saints QB Tyler Shough a compliment by referring to him as a "poor man's Josh Allen," the New Orleans coaches turned it into a joke, dubbing Shough "Poor man" for the rest of the week.
